title: Assembly constituency crosswalk row (eci_no <-> lgd_ac_id)
description: Logical contract for one row of datasets/taxonomy/ac_crosswalk.parquet. The single Canonical Data Model table binding ECI's per-state ballot number (eci_no, the citizen-facing display + URL label) to the LGD Assembly Constituency code (lgd_ac_id, the canonical INTERNAL join key). One row per (state_code, eci_no), total over every SoT AC. lgd_ac_id is nullable: a row with match_method=unmapped has no resolved LGD code yet (e.g. U08/J&K post-2022 delimitation). entity_id stays the PK per ADR-0044; this table is a derived join surface, not an identity reassignment. Authored for the eci_no -> lgd_ac_id corpus migration (TODO/20260530-eci-to-lgd-acid-migration-plan.md Row A1, ADR-0049).

x-changelog.description: Initial ac_crosswalk schema. Columns: state_code, eci_no (PK pair), lgd_ac_id (nullable), ac_id, ac_name, delim_year, match_method, source_id. Binds eci_no to lgd_ac_id as the canonical AC join key per ADR-0049; harvested from boundary AC_ID provenance (~30 covered states) in Row A2.

state_code.description: ECI state code (e.g. S22 for Tamil Nadu, U08 for Jammu and Kashmir). First half of the PK.

eci_no.description: ECI numeric AC number within the state. The citizen-facing display + URL label. Second half of the PK; (state_code, eci_no) is total over every SoT AC.

lgd_ac_id.description: LGD Assembly Constituency code (canonical INTERNAL join key), globally unique where non-null. Composed by the publisher as 2-digit State_LGD + 3-digit ac_no (e.g. 28145). Null when match_method=unmapped (no resolved LGD code yet, e.g. U08/J&K).

ac_id.description: The AC entity_id (= dim_acs PK), e.g. 'IN-S22-AC-2008-167'. entity_id remains the PK per ADR-0044; this column lets the crosswalk join cleanly to dim_acs and observations.

ac_name.description: Display name as printed by ECI (e.g. 'Mylapore'). Nullable when upstream omitted it. The citizen URL slug is derived from this; this is the canonical label.

delim_year.description: Delimitation cycle year (typically 2008 post-delimitation; 2022 for J&K). Disambiguates the (state_code, eci_no) pair across delimitation breaks.

match_method.description: How lgd_ac_id was bound to eci_no. 'lgd_direct' = boundary AC_ID ac_no equals eci_no (numbering coincides). 'name_reservation_join' = bound by (name, reservation) where ECI and LGD numbering diverge (e.g. 'Pre delimitation' features). 'unmapped' = no LGD code resolved yet; lgd_ac_id is null and consumers fall back to ac_no/eci_no.

source_id.description: FK -> taxonomy/sources.parquet. Provenance of the lgd_ac_id binding (the boundary snapshot or SoT file that supplied the LGD code).
